info.name: Grafana Route Get Alert Rules Export

params.name: download
params.description: Whether to initiate a download of the file or not.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the downloaded file. Supported yaml, json or hcl. Accept header can also be used, but the query parameter will take precedence.

params.name: folderUid
params.description: UIDs of folders from which to export rules

params.name: group
params.description: Name of group of rules to export. Must be specified only together with a single folder UID

params.name: ruleUid
params.description: UID of alert rule to export. If specified, parameters folderUid and group must be empty.

items.docs: This API operation retrieves alert rules from Grafana in an exportable format, allowing administrators to extract alert rule configurations for backup, migration, or version control purposes. The GET endpoint at /v1/provisioning/alert-rules/export provides a way to programmatically access the complete definition of configured alert rules, including their conditions, notification settings, and metadata. items.docs: The Get Alert Rule Export endpoint allows you to export a specific alert rule configuration from Grafana by providing its unique identifier (UID). This operation retrieves the complete alert rule definition in a format suitable for provisioning, enabling you to back up, version control, or migrate alert rules between Grafana instances. items.docs: This API operation retrieves and exports the complete policy tree structure from Grafana's provisioning system.
